characters.name: Bjørnen
characters.prompt: A large Norwegian brown bear from the 1400-1850 era, with thick fur and a slightly shortened tail, standing on icy ground in a snowy Norwegian forest, wearing a simple rustic vest that hints at old Norwegian clothing.

characters.name: Ræven
characters.prompt: A sly red fox with fluffy fur, dressed in ragged but cunning-looking attire from old Norwegian fashion (1400-1850). The fox has an alert stance, a crafty grin, and is carrying a small bundle of ‘stolen’ fish.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate the old Norwegian folktale “Bjørnen og Ræven” set in a snowy forest between 1400 and 1850. Show the Bear sitting on ice with his tail dipped into a fishing hole, looking puzzled, while the Fox stands nearby, smirking mischievously. In the background, depict a hidden butter tub under a fir tree and the Fox having just stolen butter, leaving the Bear to blame. Use warm, painterly tones reminiscent of traditional Norwegian art, focusing on the era’s rustic feel and wintery landscape.
modernMainImagePrompt: Reimagine “The Bear and the Fox” in contemporary Norway. Show the Bear dressed in modern casual clothes, awkwardly attempting to fish through a small hole in ice using a modern fishing rod, and the Fox wearing trendy streetwear while texting or snapping pictures. Include signs of modern life (like a parked snowmobile or a distant cabin with electric lights) for a believable 21st-century Norwegian setting.
childMainImagePrompt: Create a bright, friendly cartoon scene of the Bear and the Fox for a 5-year-old audience. The Bear is playfully sitting on the ice (with his short tail held above the hole) and the Fox stands nearby, looking curious but kind, holding a little pot of butter. The setting is a whimsical Norwegian winter wonderland filled with soft colors, gently falling snow, and charming scenery. Keep the style cheerful, ensuring the characters appear cuddly and approachable.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Lag et illustrert bilde som viser Bjørnen og Ræven i en enkel, moderne norsk setting. Bjørnen står på isen med halen i vannet, mens Ræven lurer bak et grantre med smørkrukka. Bruk klare farger og en lett gjenkjennelig, vennlig atmosfære, der det tydelig fremgår at Ræven har narret Bjørnen.
englishMainImagePrompt: Provide a vivid illustration depicting the Bear and the Fox in a snowy Norwegian landscape of olden days. Show the Bear with his tail stuck in a frozen fishing hole, looking distressed, while the clever Fox sneaks away with the butter. The scene should capture the playful tension between the two animals, reflecting the traditional Norwegian folktale style and atmosphere. Emphasize the historical winter setting with tall pine trees and soft, muted colors.
